paragraphs: In November 2024, the board of directors of Liberty Media Corporation ("Liberty Media") authorized Liberty Media management to pursue a plan to split-off the Liberty Live Group (the "Split-Off"), which was completed on December 15, 2025. Immediately prior to effecting the Split-Off, Liberty Media's subsidiary Quint, interests in certain private assets and $171.7 million of cash were reattributed from Liberty Media's Formula One Group to its Liberty Live Group in exchange for interests in certain other private assets. Liberty Media effected the Split-Off through the redemption of Liberty Media's Liberty Live common stock in exchange for Liberty Live Group common stock of a newly formed company called Liberty Live Holdings, Inc. ("Liberty Live" or the "Company"). Liberty Media redeemed each outstanding share of its Series A, Series B and Series C Liberty Live common stock for one share of the corresponding series of Liberty Live Group common stock of Liberty Live.

Liberty Live beneficially owns approximately 69.6 million shares of Live Nation common stock, Quint, interests in certain private assets, corporate cash and debt obligations attributed to the Liberty Live Group.

Following the Split-Off, Liberty Media and Liberty Live operate as separate, publicly traded companies, and neither has any continuing stock ownership, beneficial or otherwise, in the other. In connection with the Split-Off, Liberty Media and Liberty Live entered into certain agreements in order to govern certain of the ongoing relationships between the two companies after the Split-Off and to provide for an orderly transition. These agreements include a services agreement, an aircraft time sharing agreement, and a facilities sharing agreement (the "Ancillary Agreements") in addition to a reorganization agreement and a tax sharing agreement.

The reorganization agreement provides for, among other things, the principal corporate transactions (including the internal restructuring) required to effect the Split-Off, certain conditions to the Split-Off and provisions governing the relationship between Liberty Live and Liberty Media with respect to and resulting from the Split-Off. The tax sharing agreement provides for the allocation and indemnification of tax liabilities and benefits between Liberty Media and Liberty Live and other agreements related to tax matters. Pursuant to the services agreement, Liberty Media provides Liberty Live with general and administrative services including legal, tax, accounting, treasury and investor relations support. Liberty Live reimburses Liberty Media for direct, out-of-pocket expenses and pays a services fee to Liberty Media under the services agreement that is subject to adjustment quarterly, as necessary. Under the facilities sharing agreement, Liberty Live shares office space with Liberty Media and related amenities at Liberty Media's corporate headquarters. The aircraft time sharing agreement provides for Liberty Media to lease its aircraft to Liberty Live for use on a periodic, non-exclusive time sharing basis.

A portion of Liberty Media's general and administrative expenses, including legal, tax, accounting, treasury and investor relations support was previously allocated to the Liberty Live Group each reporting period based on an estimate of time spent. The Liberty Live Group paid $25.8 million and $5.2 million during the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively, for shared services and other directly incurred expenses, which are reflected in the consolidated statements of operations in selling, general and administrative expenses. Future amounts allocated to Liberty Live through the Ancillary Agreements are expected to be approximately $9.0 million annually. Additionally, Liberty Live expects to incur corporate overhead expenses primarily related to being a standalone public company of approximately $8.0 million annually.
The following are our more significant subsidiaries and minority investments:
Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. (NYSE: LYV)
Live Nation believes it is the largest live entertainment company in the world, connecting over 805 million fans across all of its concerts and ticketing platforms in 55 countries during 2025.

Live Nation believes it is the largest producer of live music concerts in the world, based on total fans that attend Live Nation events as compared to events of other promoters, connecting 159 million fans to over 11,000 artists at 55,000 events in 2025. Live Nation owns, operates, has exclusive booking rights for or has an equity interest in 460 venues globally, including House of Blues® music venues and prestigious locations such as The Fillmore® in San Francisco, Brooklyn Bowl® in New York City, the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles, the Moody Center© arena in Austin, the Ziggo Dome in Amsterdam, 3Arena in Dublin, Royal Arena in Copenhagen and Spark Arena in Auckland.

Live Nation believes it is one of the world's leading artist management companies based on the number of artists represented. Live Nation's artist management companies manage music artists and acts across all music genres.

Live Nation believes it is the world's leading live entertainment ticketing sales and marketing company, based on the number of tickets it sells. Ticketmaster provides ticket sales services and marketing and distribution globally through www.ticketmaster.com and www.livenation.com and Live Nation's mobile apps, other websites and numerous retail outlets, distributing 646 million tickets through Live Nation's systems in 2025. Ticketmaster serves 10,500 clients worldwide across multiple event categories, providing ticketing services for leading arenas, stadiums, festival and concert promoters, professional sports franchises and leagues, college sports teams, performing arts venues, museums and theaters.

Live Nation believes its global footprint is one of the world's largest music advertising networks for corporate brands and includes one of the world's leading ecommerce websites based on a comparison of gross sales of top internet retailers.

At December 31, 2025, the Company beneficially owned approximately 69.6 million shares of Live Nation Common Stock ("LYV"), which represented approximately 30% of the issued and outstanding shares of Live Nation as of December 31, 2025. Based on a review of Live Nation's public filings as of January 31, 2026, no other holder of shares of LYV holds more than 10% of such shares.

In connection with the Split-Off, Liberty Live entered into the New Holder Assignment and Assumption Agreement, dated as of December 15, 2025, with Liberty Media and Live Nation, which provided for Liberty Media's assignment and transfer of, and the assumption by Liberty Live of, Liberty Media's rights, benefits, liabilities and obligations under the Stockholder Agreement, dated as of February 10, 2009, by and among Live Nation, Liberty Media and certain other parties (as assigned, the "Stockholder Agreement").

headings: Risk Factor Summary
Factors Relating to our Corporate History and the Split-Off
The historical financial information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K is not necessarily representative of our future financial position, future results of operations or future cash flows.
We have incurred, and will continue to incur, costs as a result of becoming an independent public company.
Our inter-company agreements were negotiated while we were still a subsidiary of Liberty Media.
Prior to the completion of the Split-Off, we had no operating history as a separate company upon which you can evaluate our performance.
We may not realize the potential benefits from the Split-Off in the near term or at all.
Factors Relating to Our Company, as a Whole
We have overlapping directors and officers with Liberty Media and Liberty Broadband, and overlapping officers with GCI Liberty, which may lead to conflicting interests.
We are a holding company, and may be unable to obtain cash in amounts sufficient to service our financial obligations or meet our other commitments.
We may become subject to the Investment Company Act.
We or our subsidiaries may not realize the benefits of acquisitions or other strategic investments and initiatives.
We have significant indebtedness.
Our ability to incur additional indebtedness to fund our operations could be limited, which could negatively impact our operations.
The unfavorable outcome of pending or future litigation could have a material adverse impact on our and/or our subsidiaries' operations and financial condition.
Factors Relating to our Businesses
We have a different management team from Live Nation, which means we do not have direct control over how Live Nation operates on a day-to-day basis.
Our equity method investment in Live Nation may have a material impact on our net earnings (loss).

Live Nation is dependent upon their ability to lease, acquire and develop live music venues, and if Live Nation is unable to do so on acceptable terms, or at all, their results of operations could be adversely affected.

("Liberty Live" or the "Company"). Following the Split-Off, Liberty Media and Liberty Live operate as separate, publicly traded companies, and neither has any continuing stock ownership, beneficial or otherwise, in the other. These agreements include a services agreement, an aircraft time sharing agreement, and a facilities sharing agreement (the "Ancillary Agreements") in addition to a reorganization agreement and a tax sharing agreement.

The reorganization agreement provides for, among other things, the principal corporate transactions (including the internal restructuring) required to effect the Split-Off, certain conditions to the Split-Off and provisions governing the relationship between Liberty Live and Liberty Media with respect to and resulting from the Split-Off. The tax sharing agreement provides for the allocation and indemnification of tax liabilities and benefits between Liberty Media and Liberty Live and other agreements related to tax matters. Quint designs, develops, and sells official ticket-inclusive hospitality and single to multi-day experiential packages (including on or off-site experiences, transportation, and hotel accommodations) throughout the world, and is a reportable segment. Live Nation believes it is the largest producer of live music concerts in the world, it is the world's leading live entertainment ticketing sales and marketing company, its global footprint is one of the world's largest music advertising networks for corporate brands and includes one of the world's leading ecommerce websites. As a result, Live Nation believes it is the largest live entertainment company in the world, connecting over 805 million fans across all of its concerts and ticketing platforms in 55 countries during 2025, and is a reportable segment. Our "Corporate and other" category includes corporate activity along with various equity investments.

A weak or uncertain economy in the U.S. or globally could adversely affect demand for Live Nation's and Quint's services and events. Live Nation's and Quint's businesses depend on discretionary consumer and corporate spending, which typically falls during times of economic recession or instability. Many factors related to corporate spending and discretionary consumer spending, including actual or perceived economic conditions affecting disposable consumer income such as unemployment levels, fuel prices, interest rates, changes in tax rates and tax laws that impact companies or individuals, and inflation can significantly impact Live Nation's and Quint's operating results. There remains a high level of uncertainty in the current macroeconomic and geopolitical environments. Economic tensions and changes in international trade policies, including, for example, the widespread tariffs announced by the U.S. on its major trading partners, higher tariffs on imported goods and materials and actions taken in response (such as retaliatory tariffs or other trade protectionist measures or the renegotiation of free trade agreements), have increased inflationary cost pressures and recessionary fears. If economic and financial market conditions in the U.S. or other key markets, including Europe, continue to be uncertain or deteriorate, customers may respond by suspending, delaying or further reducing their discretionary spending. A reduction in discretionary spending could adversely affect revenue through reduced live-entertainment and sporting event expenditures. Accordingly, the ability of Live Nation and/or Quint to increase or maintain revenue and earnings could be adversely affected to the extent that relevant economic environments remain weak or decline further. In addition, inflationary pressures, which have been significant and remain significant, may increase operational costs, including labor costs, and elevated interest rates or any further increases in interest rates in response to concerns about inflation may have the effect of further increasing economic uncertainty and heightening these risks. Business conditions, as well as various industry conditions, including corporate marketing and promotional spending and interest levels, can also significantly impact Live Nation's and Quint's operating results. These factors can affect attendance at Live Nation's and Quint's events, premium seat sales, sponsorship, advertising and hospitality spending, concession and merchandise sales, as well as the financial results of sponsors of Live Nation's and Quint's venues, events and the industry. There can be no assurance that consumer and corporate spending will not be adversely impacted by ongoing uncertainty in the macroeconomic and political environments, or by any future deterioration in such environments, thereby possibly impacting Live Nation's and Quint's operating results and growth.

Live Nation's strategy is to grow the global live entertainment industry by connecting artists with its fans, selling more tickets and partnering with additional sponsors. Live Nation invests nearly $15 billion annually in artist performances – from club and theater acts to global superstars – more than any other company in the industry. In addition, Live Nation is investing in venue infrastructure around the world to support artists, meet rising fan demand and strengthen its long-term growth.

Live Nation's core businesses surrounding the promotion of live events include ticketing and sponsorship and advertising. Live Nation believes its focus on growing these businesses will increase shareholder value as it continues to enhance its revenue streams. In Live Nation's ticketing business, it serves artists, venues, and sports teams and leagues to secure content and tickets as well as invest in technology to build innovative products which advance its ticketing, including mobile platforms and advertising. Lastly, Live Nation is paid by sponsors and advertisers that want to connect its brands with a passionate fan base.

● Expand Live Nation's Concert Platform. Live Nation will deliver more shows, grow its fan base and increase its ticket sales by continuing to build Live Nation's portfolio of concerts globally, expanding its business into additional top global music markets, and further building its presence in existing markets. Through Live Nation's culture of serving artists and a focus on supporting the development of emerging artists, Live Nation believes it can continue to expand its concert base.

● Grow Live Nation's Revenue per Show. Live Nation will grow its revenue per show across its venues through more effective ticket pricing, broader ticketing distribution and more targeted promotional marketing. Live Nation will also grow Live Nation's onsite fan monetization by improving ease of purchase, through improved onsite food and beverage and other products, merchandising, and enhanced experiences for Live Nation's fans.

● Invest in Venue Infrastructure and Enhancement Projects. To support the continued growth of artists and global fan demand, Live Nation is investing capital expenditures to expand its venue footprint – focusing on large theaters, amphitheaters, arenas and stadiums - to more markets around the world and upgrading its existing venues to enhance hospitality efforts for the fan base.

paragraphs: 2024年11月，Liberty Media Corporation（"Liberty Media"）董事會授權Liberty Media管理階層執行計畫，將Liberty Live Group（"Split-Off"）分拆出去，該分拆於2025年12月15日完成。在執行Split-Off前，Liberty Media的子公司Quint，以及某些私人資產權益及171.7百萬美元現金，自Liberty Media的Formula One Group重新歸屬至Liberty Live Group，以換取某些其他私人資產權益。Liberty Media透過將其Liberty Live普通股贖回，換取新成立公司Liberty Live Holdings, Inc.（"Liberty Live" 或 "Company"）的Liberty Live Group普通股，完成Split-Off。Liberty Media將其所有Series A、Series B及Series C Liberty Live普通股贖回，換取對應系列的Liberty Live Group普通股。
Liberty Live beneficially owns約69.6百萬 shares of Live Nation普通股，Quint，某些私人資產權益，公司現金及歸屬至Liberty Live Group的債務義務。

Split-Off後，Liberty Media與Liberty Live作為獨立、公開上市的公司運作，雙方均無任何持續的股票持有權益，包括有益或無益的權益。為管理Split-Off後雙方持續的關係及提供有序過渡，Liberty Media與Liberty Live簽訂若干協議。這些協議包括服務協議、飛機時段共享協議及設施共享協議（"Ancillary Agreements"），以及重組協議與稅務共享協議。

重組協議規範，包括內部重組在內的主體公司交易，Split-Off的條件，以及Liberty Live與Liberty Media之間因Split-Off產生的關係。稅務共享協議規範Liberty Media與Liberty Live之間稅務負擔與利益的分攤與賠償，以及其他與稅務相關的協議。根據服務協議，Liberty Media為Liberty Live提供一般及行政服務，包括法律、稅務、會計、財務及投資者關係支援。Liberty Live償還Liberty Media的直接、實支費用，並根據服務協議支付服務費用，該費用每季調整一次。根據設施共享協議，Liberty Live與Liberty Media共享辦公室空間及相關設施於Liberty Media的總部。飛機時段共享協議規範Liberty Media將其飛機租賃給Liberty Live，用於定期、非獨佔的時段共享。

Liberty Media的部分一般及行政費用，包括法律、稅務、會計、財務及投資者關係支援，先前根據預估時間分配至Liberty Live Group。Liberty Live Group於2025年12月31日及2024年12月31日結帳年度，分別支付25.8百萬美元及5.2百萬美元，用以支付共享服務及其他直接費用，這些費用反映在合併營運費用表的銷售、一般及行政費用中。未來根據Ancillary Agreements分配至Liberty Live的金額預計每年約為9.0百萬美元。此外，Liberty Live預期將產生約8.0百萬美元的公司運作費用，主要與成為獨立公開上市公司相關。
以下為我們較重要的子公司及少數投資：
Live Nation Entertainment, Inc. (NYSE: LYV)
Live Nation認為其為全球最大現場娛樂公司，在2025年透過其所有演唱會及售票平台，連接超過805百萬名粉絲，遍及55個國家。

Live Nation 認為它是全球最大的現場音樂演唱會製造商，根據總共參與 Live Nation 活動的粉絲人數與其他 promoters 之活動比較，於 2025 年連接 159 百萬粉絲至超過 11,000 位藝人於 55,000 場活動。Live Nation 自有、營運、擁有獨家預訂權或具備股權利益於全球 460 個場地，包括 House of Blues® 音樂場地以及知名場地如 The Fillmore® 在舊金山、Brooklyn Bowl® 在紐約市、好萊塢 Palladium 在洛杉磯、Moody Center© 舞臺在奧斯汀、Ziggo Dome 在阿姆斯特丹、3Arena 在都柏林、Royal Arena 在哥本哈根以及 Spark Arena 在奧克蘭。
Live Nation 認為其為全球領先的藝人管理公司，根據所代表藝人數量。Live Nation 的藝人管理公司管理各類音樂風格的音樂藝人及表演團體。

Live Nation 認為它是全球領先的現場娛樂票務銷售與行銷公司，基於其銷售的票數。Ticketmaster 提供全球範圍的票務銷售服務與行銷與分銷，透過 www.ticketmaster.com 和 www.livenation.com 以及 Live Nation 的行動應用程式、其他網站和眾多零售據點，於 2025 年透過 Live Nation 的系統分銷 646 百萬張票務。Ticketmaster 全球服務 10,500 家客戶，涵蓋多種活動類別，為領先的體育館、體育場、音樂節與演唱會 promoters、職業體育俱樂部與聯盟、大學體育隊、表演藝術場地、博物館與劇院提供票務服務。
Live Nation 認為其全球版圖為全球最大的企業品牌音樂廣告網路之一，並包含根據頂級網際網路零售商總銷售額比較，其中一項全球領先的電商網站。
於 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司受益所有約 69.6 百萬股 Live Nation 普通股（"LYV"），此數量約佔 Live Nation 已發行及流通股數之 30%。根據截至 2026 年 1 月 31 日 Live Nation 公開檔之審閱，無其他 LYV 股東持有超過 10% 之 LYV 股數。

關於 Split-Off，Liberty Live 與 Liberty Media 及 Live Nation 簽訂於 2025 年 12 月 15 日的 New Holder Assignment and Assumption Agreement，該協議規定 Liberty Media 將其權利、利益、負債及義務轉讓給 Liberty Live，並由 Liberty Live 承擔根據 2009 年 2 月 10 日由 Live Nation、Liberty Media 及其他當事人簽訂的 Stockholder Agreement（經轉讓後，稱為 "Stockholder Agreement"）。

2024 年 11 月，Liberty Media Corporation（"Liberty Media" 或 "母公司"）董事會批准 Liberty Media 管理層執行計畫，將 Liberty Live Group（"分拆"）分拆出去，該分拆於 2025 年 12 月 15 日完成。在執行分拆前，Liberty Media 的子公司 QuintEvents, LLC（"Quint"）以及某些私人資產的權益與 171.7 百萬美元現金，自 Liberty Media 的 Formula One Group 轉移至其 Liberty Live Group，以換取某些其他私人資產的權益。Liberty Media 透過將其 Liberty Live 普通股贖回，換取新成立公司 Liberty Live Holdings, Inc.（"Liberty Live" 或 "本公司"）的 Liberty Live Group 普通股，完成分拆。Liberty Media 贏得其所有 Series A、Series B 和 Series C Liberty Live 普通股，換取對應系列的 Liberty Live 普通股。
Liberty Live 目前擁有 Live Nation Entertainment, Inc.（"Live Nation"）約 69.6 百萬股普通股，Quint、某些私人資產的權益、公司現金及債務義務。
分拆後，Liberty Media 與 Liberty Live 運作為兩家獨立上市的公司，且雙方均無任何持續的股票權益，包括有益所有權。為配合分拆，Liberty Media 與 Liberty Live 籤訂若干協議，以規範分拆後雙方之間的持續關係，並確保過渡過程順利進行。這些協議包括服務協議、飛機時段共享協議及設施共享協議（"附屬協議"），以及重組協議與稅務共享協議。

重組協議規範，除其他事項外，為實現分拆所需的主要企業交易（包括內部重整）、分拆的條件，以及 Liberty Live 與 Liberty Media 之間因分拆而產生的關係。稅務共享協議規範 Liberty Media 與 Liberty Live 之間稅務負擔與利益的分配與賠償，以及與稅務相關的其他協議。根據服務協議，Liberty Media 向 Liberty Live 提供一般及行政服務，包括法律、稅務、會計、財務及投資者關係支援。Liberty Live 會償還 Liberty Media 所產生的直接、實支費用，並根據服務協議支付服務費用，費用每季調整一次。根據設施共享協議，Liberty Live 會與 Liberty Media 共享辦公室空間及相關設施於 Liberty Media 的總部。飛機
時段共享協議規範 Liberty Media 將其飛機出租給 Liberty Live，用於定期、非獨佔的時段共享用途。

Liberty Media 一般及行政費用中的一部分，包括法律、稅務、會計、財務及投資者關係支援，過去每個會計期間均根據預估耗用時間分配至 Liberty Live Group。Liberty Live Group 在 2025 年 12 月 31 日結止年度及 2024 年 12 月 31 日結止年度，分別支付 25.8 百萬美元及 5.2 百萬美元，用以支付共享服務及其他直接產生費用，這些費用反映在合併營運費用表中之銷售、一般及行政費用。根據附屬協議，未來分配至 Liberty Live 的金額預計每年約為 9.0 百萬美元。此外，Liberty Live 預期每年將產生約 8.0 百萬美元的公司總體費用，主要與成為獨立上市公司的相關費用有關。

美國或全球總體經濟若處於疲弱或不確定狀態，可能會對 Live Nation 及 Quint 的服務及活動需求產生負面影響。Live Nation 及 Quint 的業務依賴於消費者的自願性支出與企業支出，而這些支出通常在經濟衰退或不穩定時期會減少。與企業支出及自願性消費支出相關的許多因素，包括實際或被認為影響可支配所得的經濟條件，例如失業率、燃料價格、利率、稅率及稅法變動，以及通貨膨脹，都可能對 Live Nation 及 Quint 的營運結果產生重大影響。目前總體經濟與地緣政治環境仍存在高度不確定性。經濟緊張與國際貿易政策的變動，包括例如美國對其主要貿易夥伴廣泛徵收關稅、對進口商品與材料提高關稅以及相關回應措施（例如報復性關稅或其他貿易保護主義措施或重新談判自由貿易協議），已增加通貨膨脹成本壓力與經濟衰退的擔憂。如果美國或其他關鍵市場，包括歐洲的經濟與金融市場條件持續不確定或惡化，客戶可能會回應而暫停、延後或進一步減少其自願性支出。自願性支出的減少可能會透過減少現場娛樂與體育賽事支出而對收入產生負面影響。因此，Live Nation 及/或 Quint 增加或維持收入與獲利的能力，可能因相關經濟環境持續疲弱或進一步惡化而受到負面影響。此外，通貨膨脹壓力，已顯著且持續存在，可能增加營運成本，包括人工成本，而高利率或任何進一步提高利率的措施，因對通貨膨脹的擔憂，可能會增加經濟不確定性，並提高這些風險。營運條件，以及各項產業條件，包括企業行銷與促銷支出與利率水平，也可能對 Live Nation 及 Quint 的營運結果產生重大影響。這些因素可能影響 Live Nation 及 Quint 的活動參與人數、高價座位銷售、贊助、廣告與休閒支出、販賣與商品銷售，以及 Live Nation 及 Quint 的場地、活動與產業贊助者的財務結果。無法保證消費者與企業支出不會因總體經濟與政治環境的持續不確定性，或任何未來的環境惡化而受到負面影響，進而可能影響 Live Nation 及 Quint 的營運結果與成長。
Live Nation 的策略是透過連結藝人與其粉絲、銷售更多票券與與更多贊助商合作，來成長全球現場娛樂產業。Live Nation 每年投入近 15 十億美元用於藝人表演 – 從俱樂部與劇院演出到全球巨星 – 是產業中投入最多的公司。此外，Live Nation 也在全球投資場地基礎建設，以支持藝人、應對日益增長的粉絲需求並強化其長期成長。

Live Nation 周圍的核心業務包括現場活動的推廣，包含票務與贊助與廣告。Live Nation 相信其對這些業務的重視將增加股東價值，同時持續提升其收入來源。在 Live Nation 的票務業務中，其服務藝人、場地與體育隊伍與聯盟，以取得內容與票券，並投資於技術以建立創新產品，進而提升其票務業務，包括行動平台與廣告。最後，Live Nation 會由希望將品牌與熱情粉絲連結的贊助商與廣告商支付費用。
● 擴展 Live Nation 的演唱會平台。Live Nation 將透過持續建立全球演唱會組合，擴大其演唱會規模、增長其粉絲羣體與增加其票券銷售，來提供更多演唱會。透過 Live Nation 服務藝人的文化與支持新興藝人發展的重點，Live Nation 相信其可以持續擴展其演唱會規模。
● 提升 Live Nation 每場演唱會的收入。Live Nation 將透過更有效的票價設定、更廣泛的票務分銷與更具針對性的促銷行銷，來提升其場地每場演唱會的收入。Live Nation 也會透過改善購票便利性、提升場內餐飲與其他產品、商品販售與提升 Live Nation 粉絲的體驗，來增加 Live Nation 的場內粉絲收入。
● 投資場地基礎建設與改善計畫。為支持藝人持續成長與全球粉絲需求，Live Nation 正投資資本支出以擴展其場地規模 – 聚焦於大型劇院、音樂廳、體育館與體育場 – 進入更多全球市場，並改善現有場地以提升對粉絲的休閒服務。

與本公司歷史及分拆有關的因子

本公司因成為獨立上市公司而產生，並將持續產生相關成本
本公司與其他公司的合約係在本公司仍為Liberty Media子公司期間所協議
分拆完成前，本公司作為獨立公司之營運歷史尚無，因此無法據以評估本公司之績效
本公司可能在近期內或完全無法實現分拆之潛在好處
與本公司整體有關之因子
本公司與 Liberty Media 及 Liberty Broadband 有重複的董事及高階主管，且與 GCI Liberty 有重複的高階主管，這可能會導致利益衝突。
本公司為控股公司，可能無法取得足夠現金以償還財務義務或履行其他承諾。
本公司或其子公司可能面臨投資公司法的適用。
本公司或其子公司可能無法實現收購或其他戰略投資及計畫的效益。
本公司負擔重大債務。
本公司因應資金需求而增加債務的能力可能受到限制，這可能會對本公司營運造成負面影響。
待決或未來訴訟的不利結果，可能對本公司及/或其子公司營運及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
與本公司業務相關的因素
我們擁有與 Live Nation 不同的管理團隊，這表示我們無法直接控制 Live Nation 日常運作的方式。
我們對 Live Nation 的權益法投資，可能對我們的淨收益（損失）產生重大影響。
Live Nation 依賴其租賃、購買新興音樂場地及開發現場音樂場地的能力，若 Live Nation 無法以可接受的條件或完全無法做到，其營運結果可能受到不利影響。
paragraphs: 投資本公司普通股涉及風險。在投資本公司普通股之前，除 Part II 中 Item 7（"管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析"）所描述之其他資訊外，您應謹慎考量下列風險。這些風險並非唯一與本公司業務與資本結構相關之風險。下列所描述之風險被認為是最重要之風險。然而，可能還有其他未預見或無法預測之經濟、業務、競爭、法規或其他因素，也可能對本公司業務產生重大不利影響。過去之財務表現未必為未來表現之可靠指標，歷史趨勢亦不應用以預測未來期間之結果或趨勢。若下列所描述之任何事件或本文件所引用之文件中所述之事件發生，將可能對本公司業務、前景、財務狀況、營運結果及/或現金流產生重大不利影響，進而可能對本公司普通股之價值產生重大不利影響。
